title: Conversation pane: streaming chat, chat switcher, summary card, suggested questions
description: Chat-first right pane of the paper workspace: thread with user bubbles and assistant prose, docked composer with model switcher and Stop, chat switcher with rename/delete, summary as the first card with versions and job stages, suggested questions from hw1.
acceptance_criteria: Given a ready paper with no chats, when the user asks a suggested question, then a chat is created, the URL contains /chats/:chatId, and the answer streams with inline page chips.
Given streaming, when Stop generation is pressed, then the partial answer is kept as interrupted and is never re-sent automatically.
Given a summary job running, when the page reloads, then the summary card reattaches to the active job's progress.
Given a question queued from the home composer, when the chat opens under StrictMode, then exactly one request is sent.
test_cases: conversation RTL: stream, stop, stored model label, chip opens source
verification: Conversation agent, test-first. Red: 9 chat tests failed against the stub (missing 'Question about this paper' textbox and 'Suggested questions' group); the summary suite failed on an unresolved module. 2 later failures were a test bug (CTA renders after summaries load; switched to findByRole). Lint red: 5 react-hooks/refs errors (a ref read during render) fixed by passing plain props. Self-review red: a stale chat list flashed 'Conversation not found' ('expected document not to contain element'); fixed. Safeguards ported and reviewed by lead: abort on unmount, terminal guard, cross-document citation rejection, no automatic resend, StrictMode-safe queued question with fixed request_id. Stop now keeps the partial answer as Interrupted with a status message rather than an alert. Lead integration: 36 files / 162 tests, 0 lint errors. Pending: workspace integration, e2e/conversation.spec.ts serial run, streaming and summary progress visual check (needs generation). Follow-ups: shared rename/delete dialogs (refactor, 28 tests green); test-first earlier-PDF accessible name; a TDD audit naming test-first, missing-module-only and test-after work; 41 mutations, all red after 4 vacuous tests were corrected. E2E-04 and E2E-05 passed in the integrated full run (8/8, 34.5s) with the evidence jump verified on real data.
